test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 7 July 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Two statements are given, followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements**:

All Books are Pens.

All Pens are Pencils.

**Conclusions:**

I. All Books are Pencils.

II. All Pencils are Books.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow.
Neither conclusion I nor II follows.

solution:
Statement:

All Books are Pens.

All Pens are Pencils.

The least possible diagram for the given statements is as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d3c07d0abe86079d9105f752db987406c37180305bb6b4ec7651f94ef80be9f8.png] 

Conclusions:

(i) All Books are Pencils - **True** (Because All Books are Pens and All Pens are Pencils, so All Books are Pencil also).

(ii) All Pencils are Books - False (All Pencils are Books can be possible not definitely).

Here, Only conclusion I follows.

Hence, the correct answer is **"**Option 3".
